release_notes.8a892bd2d838: Refreshed mobile and web settings with clearer sections, new icons, visual choices, quick navigation, and search.
release_notes.ab580a68987c: Add Reviews, Critical Items, or Streak widgets to your Android home screen in small or medium sizes, with the same artwork and color themes as iOS. Choose your widget content and colors in Widgets settings.
release_notes.ae52470fc9c8: Save up to 3 presets with custom batch sizes and review orders, then select one from the Home review card. Enable Review Presets under Review Batch Size in advanced Review Settings.
release_notes.6414b2dc9f8e: Use 1–4 to select multiple choice answers with an external keyboard on mobile and iPad, or in the web app.
release_notes.6c0926f87a91: Set a target level, timeframe, or calendar date with a guided setup, then track your progress on the Level screen. Update or remove your goal through Edit goal.
release_notes.f166d17c41c4: Link your level pace and daily lessons, preview estimated reviews, and choose a review session size in Review forecast. Apply your daily plan or use its target date for your goal. Enable Plan your pace under Review forecast in Home Customization; off by default.
release_notes.d353ff13ded9: Save stories for later, even after they leave the feed. Find them in Saved articles or use the Saved only filter.
release_notes.f0c3461a0e5f: Select subjects in the In List tab to copy or move them to another list.
release_notes.e9d39d1f5ccc: Enable more tabs in Customize Tabs. Extra tabs appear in a More menu when your tab bar is full.
release_notes.e8604514979e: Fixed kanji stroke order animations skipping or stopping unexpectedly in details and lessons, including when replaying an animation.
release_notes.94bbf3b1ced3: Keep track of read stories and filter for unread news. Saved on your device.
release_notes.c1fcdc8c8031: Cycle through all selected Jitai fonts with a new option in advanced Review Settings. Off by default.
release_notes.3eff1b7b585d: Keep your lowest-accuracy items on your iPhone home screen: one in the small widget or up to three in medium, with readings, meanings, and accuracy. Starts below 75% accuracy and expands to 80%, 85%, then 90% only if needed. Uses your widget background colors with readable text.
release_notes.33dfaa2a61e7: On iOS, tap the mic once to keep answering consecutive review questions, with an animated listening indicator that responds to your voice. Listening pauses during pronunciation playback. Tap the mic again to stop.
release_notes.5767283aaf3d: Improved text layouts, audio playback, Spotify sign-in, and attachment uploads on Android.
release_notes.1888f53741f8: Review on your Apple Watch and check upcoming reviews, with progress synced through your iPhone.
release_notes.883d063b3d5e: Study from cached reviews, save answers locally, and sync your progress when you're back online.
release_notes.ff84e253f67c: Fixed a crash when reviewing or opening details for kana-vocabulary words like ドキドキ.
release_notes.eea291184dc8: Added a Japanese-only option that removes translations and reveal buttons from context sentences, media examples, and patterns of use in vocabulary details and lessons.
release_notes.dab501d9239e: Multiple choice reviews now fill missing options with answers from learned items, while keeping similar choices first.
release_notes.e4ec194b547f: Notes use plain text by default. Enable formatting and subject links in Settings → Notes; existing formatted notes keep rich editing.
release_notes.d38c9b8f940e: More writing space, controls closer to the keyboard, and cleaner scrolling. Cursor position is preserved when switching modes or editing links.
release_notes.8e7a90f2917c: Optionally add Japanese text when linking a selection, with your choice remembered. Toggle linked typing without removing the existing link.
release_notes.764f445116ac: Filter vocabulary by parts of speech, including proper nouns and verbal nouns, across Search, subject lists, and study pickers.
release_notes.944bc93a297f: Enable Multiple Choice in Review Settings to choose from similar readings and related meanings instead of typing.
release_notes.692a3fc75ae0: Look up subjects from lesson cards without losing your place. Enable in advanced Lesson Settings; off by default.
release_notes.d7da65074b86: Audio Vocab quizzes now reveal the English meaning and Japanese reading together on mobile and web.
release_notes.c9384aed2f99: Listen to WaniKani recordings or text-to-speech context sentences and recall the target word’s English meaning in Extra Study.
release_notes.07baa4141b84: Fixed a crash when finishing JLPT quizzes in the mobile app.
release_notes.15a70d62d63d: Practice N5 through N1 with quick mixed-skill quizzes or timed mock exams, including listening, detailed results, and weak-area review.
release_notes.c30735b295d1: Add your own Japanese and English examples from the + button in Context Sentences, with automatic translation, kana, audio, and dedicated review practice. Sentences are saved locally on this device.
release_notes.d8abd20e4d68: News articles can now open with furigana hidden by default when using No Study Mode.
release_notes.ecbc7d71dfac: Find Japanese vocabulary hidden in a grid by matching kanji clues to kana readings, or kana clues to written words.
release_notes.327f91610b5a: Read full Standard NHK News stories with images and study highlighting, using Easy, Standard, or Both sources.
release_notes.9a6e76aac4ec: Select note text to make it bold, italic, or underlined across subject details, lessons, and reviews.
release_notes.05a11e1b4814: Extra Study quizzes now include selected Subject List items above your current level unless you enable a custom level range.
release_notes.d7d6626b9616: Copy or move every subject from one Subject List to another using the new Transfer List action under Browse.
release_notes.4ec69884ed42: Combine any Custom Review SRS stages with a maximum word-frequency rank you choose. First-time checks are cached and resume automatically if Jiten asks the app to pause.
release_notes.ceec4e6fe7ff: Fixed an issue where the answer button and Enter key could stop responding after an incorrect or skipped question, especially near the end of a lesson.
release_notes.ffa4602c5406: English to Japanese quizzes now accept matching Japanese words that share the prompted meaning.
release_notes.aaf4319b2910: Similar Kanji Match now shows each kanji’s reading after you submit a round.
release_notes.ec93c12d8df8: Pitch accent now appears only on reading cards or combined cards, so meaning cards no longer reveal the reading.
release_notes.423cfe13a1eb: Review counts now refresh more reliably when opening the app and returning from a review session.
release_notes.b18860abeaad: Vocabulary audio now starts more responsively while offline audio downloads continue in the background.
release_notes.8e9518e1a04d: Bookmark icons now appear filled when a subject is already saved to one of your lists.
release_notes.15e2994aac93: Filter available vocabulary lessons by common frequency-rank ranges.
release_notes.842cca4ef5c9: Added an advanced review setting to adjust the answer input text size.
release_notes.c4cfc3b22172: Bluetooth keyboard shortcuts now work in Anki-style reviews.
release_notes.ca63e690e107: Crossword, Wordle, and Bunpro answers now switch to a Japanese keyboard when enabled.
release_notes.85d7b59b83c5: Set Apprentice and Guru item thresholds to pause home-page lessons until reviews bring those counts back down.
release_notes.f1327ec983d6: Optionally tap On’yomi, Kun’yomi, and Nanori readings to hear them with your device’s Japanese voice in kanji details and lessons.
release_notes.5bb09e0f21aa: Context sentences in vocabulary reviews can now be scrolled into view while the keyboard is open.
release_notes.e5e05293b809: Added an optional setting to show sourced character origins and formation notes in kanji details and lessons.
release_notes.db2deb3be03f: Added JLPT word filters and audio replay for kana-only words in crossword statistics.
release_notes.43b81f8e1a57: Added a setting to group vocabulary examples by On’yomi, Kun’yomi, and Nanori.
release_notes.3c3a285ab596: Use the shortcut on a subject list row, or open the study menu from the list editor and Custom Review headers, to choose Standard Review, Kanji Match, Custom Lessons, Random Test, Similar Kanji, or Kanji Writing.
release_notes.e44735f7662c: Import TTF or OTF font files into the Jitai randomizer, with new downloadable Japanese calligraphy fonts also available.
release_notes.32542044a8a0: Filter Custom Reviews and Subject Lists by one or more JLPT levels.
release_notes.b05da87d6a81: Optionally show vocabulary frequency ranks in lessons, reviews, and subject details.
release_notes.4d4a37bdd1f1: Optionally view radical mnemonics and illustrations directly from kanji details.
release_notes.785961d34a92: Added a level-aware fill-in-the-blank mode for songs.
release_notes.a54c3cd372d1: Added optional kanji-first solutions and audio hints.
release_notes.a8d458d4b884: Added an option to turn off lesson reminders on weekends.
release_notes.23527e243d7c: Added a new Extra Study mode for practicing visually similar kanji by matching them to their meanings.
release_notes.b669b2b52de2: Level Timing now keeps excluded bars saved more reliably across refreshes, reloads, and app restarts.
release_notes.e07a51e32c11: Paste Japanese text in Extra Study to analyze its grammar and vocabulary, with optional English translation.
release_notes.fba42e011e00: Radical review and lesson quiz prompts now ask for the radical name instead of calling it a meaning question.
release_notes.d401b271123e: Added Anki settings to show compact pitch accent labels, numbers, and an optional mini graph after revealing vocabulary cards.
release_notes.7b59fa4313a8: Added 200% and 300% app text size options for more comfortable reading on Mac and other large displays.
release_notes.d09a72aa453e: Made Subject Lists easier to manage with tap-to-enter cards, rename from the edit icon, optional item previews, saved manual list ordering, and a settings menu for compact view controls.
release_notes.292faa69d8a2: Multiple-choice context sentence practice now prefers answer choices with matching parts of speech, making distractors less obvious from grammar alone.
release_notes.3ee7faec9b7d: Added an Add to Subject List action to Recent Mistakes so the current mistake batch can be saved into custom subject lists for mixed review sessions.
release_notes.15070b4df57b: Fixed interleaved lessons so lowest-level-first ordering finishes older-level items before newly unlocked level items.
release_notes.e98ab70afbe5: Added a setting to increase app text size for more comfortable reading on larger displays.
release_notes.e8d95890a257: Fixed WaniKani mnemonic rendering so malformed reading tags no longer show tag fragments in review and subject details.
release_notes.7e0162a29735: Fixed Wrap Up in reviews, custom reviews, and recent lesson reviews so tapping the wrapping-up pill restores the full remaining queue.
release_notes.48b261f84e63: Fixed meaning and reading note cards in paused review details so they can be opened and saved after an incorrect answer.
release_notes.bb9ca8748136: Added an optional review setting that shows vocabulary context sentence hints during reviews, with English translations hidden until you reveal them from the hint.
release_notes.8b3b75b10e35: The app now saves how long you spend on reviews, lessons, extra study, NHK news, songs, reading, and videos each day. Check daily, weekly, and monthly totals with averages from the new Study Time card in Analytics.
